research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vitara Biomedical is researching extracorporeal fetal and neonatal support systems. Titles such as System and method of treatment for premature fetus and Oxygenator for neonates, with abstracts describing chambers, blood oxygenators, oxygenator swap valves, and neonatal extracorporeal support, show work on artificial womb like environments. Additional work on oxygen saturation sensing, cannulator collet latches, and physiological saline solutions supports these fetal and neonatal life support platforms.
